race.comment: DENSETSU (3) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but ran a strong race last time out, finishing a narrow fourth over 1170m at Wangaratta. Finds the right race this time and can get the job done. DEEKAYGEEBEE (2) finished just out of the money when resuming last start over 1080m at Canberra Acton. Finds the right race this time and can find winning form. GRINZINGER NYX (5) struggled to finish off last start at Albury but should find this easier and gets the important booking of Loy. Watch for sharp improvement. DITA VON (4) went back early from her wide draw over 1180m at Gundagai last time but hit the line strongly to finish fourth. Can feature in the finish. SIMONE'S CHOICE (6) has enough early toe to offset the wide draw and give a look.
